title: Joining The Sat Sangat, The True Congregation,
summary: Loneliness is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: If only I could have the good fortune to meet some friendly; joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I ask about the Path
lifeApplication: Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
